req.title: Login rejects wrong username
req.statement: The system shall render an 'Incorrect username.' error when the supplied username is not found.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-009 requires that POST /auth/login renders 'Incorrect username.' when the supplied username does not exist. Violations fixed: test[0] was kind=negative with heuristic=EP — negative tests must use NEG heuristic, so changed to NEG. test[3] was kind=negative with heuristic=STC — STC is a state-transition heuristic appropriate for positive or boundary coverage of state changes; for a negative state-transition test the heuristic must be NEG. Fixed by changing heuristic to NEG. All other tests preserved exactly as before.

tests.name: test_login_wrong_username_shows_incorrect_username_error
preconditions: Database is initialised with seed data (users: Rahul, Anjali, Ishaan, Diya, James)
Username 'NoSuchUser' does not exist in the database
expected: Response body does NOT contain 'Incorrect password.'
trace: R-FLASKR-009: system shall render 'Incorrect username.' when username not found
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'NoSuchUser', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data
assert b'Incorrect password.' not in r.data

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    sess.clear()

r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Ghost', 'password': 'stone'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Incorrect username.' in r.data

with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    assert 'user_id' not in sess

tests.name: test_login_wrong_username_vs_wrong_password_different_messages
preconditions: Database is initialised with seed data
actions: POST /auth/login with username='NonExistent' and password='cloud' — expect 'Incorrect username.'
POST /auth/login with username='Anjali' and password='wrongpass' — expect 'Incorrect password.'
expected: First request: HTTP 200, body contains 'Incorrect username.', NOT 'Incorrect password.'
Second request: HTTP 200, body contains 'Incorrect password.', NOT 'Incorrect username.'
trace: R-FLASKR-009: decision table — wrong username and wrong password are distinct error paths with distinct messages

with app.app_context():

tests.name: test_login_empty_username_shows_incorrect_username_error
preconditions: Database is initialised with seed data
Empty string username cannot match any stored user
actions: POST /auth/login with username='' (empty string) and password='stone'
trace: R-FLASKR-009: empty username is a boundary value — no user row can match, so 'Incorrect username.' must appear
